verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud file-storage and AI app like Poly, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any setting to opt out of them. Editable Mind memories (poly-docs-57) are a related transparency feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
